text_ru: Простой людей без лошади за прошедшую неделю: {days} чел.-дн. ({pct} % рабочих дней).
meaning: Residents' lost working person-days while waiting for a horse during the previous week
intent: State the measured labour loss without advising or raising a lamp
keep: People idle not horses idle; person-days not earned labor_days; past week not lifetime total
binding_note: Proposed shared window key for horses and herd; days is a ready person-day count and pct a ready percentage not ratio; owner binds exact core fields and scope after demo; no fabricated denominator or times-100 calculation
